title: 100 Bizarre & Funny Laws Around the World

laws.law: It is legally required to allow anyone who knocks on your door into your home if they need to use the bathroom.
It is an ancient legal requirement for citizens to smile at all times, except during funerals or hospital visits.
It is illegal to own just one guinea pig because they are social animals and get lonely.
It is illegal to eat fried chicken with anything other than your hands.
It is considered a crime to forget your wife's birthday.
It is illegal to name a pig 'Napoleon'.
It is illegal for a man to dress up in a strapless dress in public, though other styles are permitted under old vagrancy laws.
The import and sale of chewing gum has been strictly banned since 1992 to maintain public cleanliness.
Feeding pigeons in St. Mark's Square is strictly banned and subject to heavy fines.
Canadian law dictates that 35% of all radio broadcast content must be produced by Canadian artists.
Wearing high heels is banned at ancient historic monuments to protect marble floors from damage.
Black cars were banned from the capital city of Ashgabat because white cars are believed to bring good luck.
It is illegal to leave your house without wearing underwear.
Taking a selfie with your back turned to a statue of Buddha is considered disrespectful and can lead to arrest.
It is illegal to change a lightbulb yourself unless you are a licensed electrician.
It is illegal to handle a salmon under suspicious circumstances under the Salmon Act of 1986.
It is illegal to paint your house any color other than white without municipal permission.
The Metabo Law requires adults aged 40-74 to have their waistlines measured annually to curb obesity.
It is illegal to pee in the ocean, though enforcement remains tricky.
Wearing noisy footwear, including wooden clogs and loud flip-flops, is banned on the island.
It is illegal to run out of gas on the Autobahn highway system.
Eating food while sitting on church steps or near public monuments in the historic center is banned.
Under ancient law, all mute swans in open water belong to the ruling Monarch.
Drying your laundry outside where it is visible from the street is illegal in certain historic coastal areas.
It was made illegal to die within city limits unless you had already purchased a spot in the local cemetery.
Dying is effectively banned on the island because the permafrost prevents bodies from decomposing.
It is illegal to walk a elephant down Market Street unless it is on a leash.
Driving blindfolded is strictly illegal across the state.
Cutting down a protected Saguaro cactus can carry a prison sentence of up to 25 years.
It is illegal to mispronounce the name of the state of Arkansas under official state code.
It is illegal to couch-surf or sleep on public property within city limits without a permit.
For a pickle to be officially recognized as a pickle, it must be able to bounce.
It is illegal to sell or wear garments made from dog or cat hair.
It is illegal to sing in public while wearing a swimsuit in certain areas.
Giving your sweetheart a box of candy that weighs more than 50 pounds is illegal.
It is illegal for minors to drink alcohol unless they are participating in a culinary program or religious service.
Mustaches are legally prohibited if the bearer has a tendency to habitually kiss other humans.
It is illegal for a man with a mustache to kiss a woman in public.
It is illegal to throw snowballs in certain towns because they are classified as missiles.
It is illegal to dye a duckling blue and offer it for sale unless at least six are sold together.
Ordering a pizza to be delivered to an unsuspecting friend without their consent can incur a $500 fine.
It is illegal to take a lion to the cinema in Baltimore.
Snoring is illegal unless all bedroom windows are closed and securely locked.
A woman's hair legally belongs to her husband, requiring his permission to cut it under old laws.
A person may not cross state lines with a duck on their head.
Using profane or vulgar language in a public place can result in a fine or up to thirty days in jail.
It is illegal to drive with an un-caged bear inside your vehicle.
It is illegal to leave a sheep un-tended in the cab of a truck.
Doughnut holes may not legally be sold within city limits in certain municipalities.
It is illegal to ride a camel on the highway.
It is illegal to collect seaweed off the beach at night.
Drivers are legally prohibited from pumping their own gasoline at retail gas stations.
It is illegal for performers to dance in public while wearing revealing costumes.
Slippers are legally forbidden from being worn in public after 10:00 PM.
It is illegal to hold a meeting where attendees are dressed in masks or disguises.
It is illegal to fall asleep with your shoes on.
It is illegal to get a whale drunk in the state of Ohio.
It is illegal to make ugly faces at a dog, as you can be fined or jailed.
It is illegal to hunt canned corn while fishing in state waters.
It is illegal to sleep on top of a refrigerator outdoors.
It is illegal to bite off another person's leg.
It is illegal to keep horses in a bathtub.
It is illegal to fall asleep in a cheese factory.
Stealing crawfish from a commercial farm is a felony offense.
It is illegal to sell one's eye under Texas state law.
It is illegal NOT to drink milk on public school property.
Women must obtain written permission from their husbands to wear false teeth.
Tickling a woman is strictly illegal under old disorderly conduct statutes.
It is illegal to pretend that one's parents are rich.
Whistling underwater is strictly forbidden.
Butter substitutes are illegal to serve in public schools unless requested by a doctor.
It is illegal to take a picture of a rabbit between January and June without a permit.
Traffic police are required by law to report all bribes they are offered by drivers.
Begging with a dog in public transit stations is banned under municipal codes.
It is illegal to buy or sell adult wild animals without a specialized permit.
Swearing or making offensive gestures in public or on social media can lead to deportation.
Witches are legally banned from flying their broomsticks higher than 150 meters.
Importing or carrying religious idols or non-Islamic religious books into the country is illegal.
It was illegal to own a dog as a pet in the capital city of Reykjavík from 1924 to 1984.
It is illegal to produce or watch animated cartoons that portray political leaders unfavorably.
Married women are legally restricted to drinking only one glass of wine in public settings.
Dueling is legal, provided both participants are registered blood donors.
All households are legally required to display the Chilean national flag during national holidays.
All radio stations must play the national anthem at midnight every single night.
Bicyclists are legally prohibited from lifting both feet off the pedals while riding.
Sunbathing topless on public beaches is strictly illegal across all non-resort islands.
It is illegal to use witchcraft or sorcery to commit a crime under local penal codes.
All high schools are permitted to keep up to one pound of uranium for educational nuclear experiments.
Bermuda shorts worn in public offices must be worn with knee-high socks and sit no more than 6 inches above the knee.
It is illegal to play firearms or fireworks within 200 yards of a church service.
Wearing camouflage clothing is illegal for anyone not in the military force.
It is illegal to sell alcohol to anyone who is visibly intoxicated.
Camouflage clothing is strictly reserved for military personnel and illegal for civilians.
Drying washing outside on balconies facing main streets is banned in historical towns.
Citizens of Monaco are legally forbidden from gambling inside the famous Monte Carlo Casino.
Divorce is strictly illegal under civil law.
It is illegal to keep animals in cages that do not allow them to stand up and turn around completely.
Lawyers are legally forbidden from charging fees based on winning a case outcome.
All public transport (busses, trains, and trams) is legally required to be free of charge for residents and tourists.
It is illegal to hold a protest or political rally without notifying the police at least 48 hours in advance.
